maddeler.e:
انفتحت (form VII)
# اِنْفَتَحْتُ (infataḥtu) /in.fa.taħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْفَتَحَ (infataḥa)
# اِنْفَتَحْتَ (infataḥta) /in.fa.taħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْفَتَحَ (infataḥa)
# اِنْفَتَحْتِ (infataḥti) /in.fa.taħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْفَتَحَ (infataḥa)
# اِنْفَتَحَتْ (infataḥat) /in.fa.ta.ħat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
